positions.name: AtlasCadenceAuthorization
positions.frame: How is the monthly Atlas rollback rehearsal cadence authorized, justified, and formally recorded as owned?
positions.why: The directive instituting monthly rehearsals (src-1) is grounded by an aphoristic equivalence that treats unrehearsed capability as no capability at all (src-2), and both are then ratified into a durable artifact via the formalized Cadence and Owner field entries (src-3, src-4). Relational and power readings converge across all four on positional authority setting a standing obligation — src-1, src-3, src-4 performing that authority directly as 'legitimate' ratification, src-2 supplying its rational-persuasion justification. There is a register tension worth holding: src-2 is pitched at a principle-level, near-constitutive register ('is a rollback we do not actually have'), while src-1/3/4 sit at a flatter decision-grade register — the group holds both without resolving which register is primary.
